basis: Cambridge 9618 2027-2029 syllabus Version 2 and the scientific defect register

records.resolution: Added processor type as an architecture/instruction-set/workload factor alongside cores, bus width, clock and cache, with direct lesson and quiz evidence.
Made security management and hardware management explicit and distinguished OS security management from antivirus utilities.
Defined a one-sided limit check, contrasted it with a two-bound range check, and added worked, practice and assessment evidence.
Established normal, abnormal and extreme/boundary as the official categories and classified outside-range values as abnormal.
Removed the old normal/boundary/erroneous category sequence from the robustness mark scheme.
Corrected every student-visible lesson identity from Section 11 to Paper 2 Section 12.3 without changing its URL or number.
Removed the claim that testing proves a validation rule works and replaced it with comparison of actual and expected results for selected cases.
Reserved mobile bottom and scroll padding using the measured toolbar height plus safe-area inset and bumped the generated stylesheet version.
